landing.faq1Q: How can I get my business listed in the directory?
landing.faq1A: Click 'Submit Your Business' or email your details (company name, website, address, category, hosted logo URL) to mail@nordible.co. Our team will verify and list you promptly.
landing.faq2Q: Is a basic business listing in Nordible for Businesses free?
landing.faq2A: Yes, standard verified listings for legitimate businesses and partners are permanently free.
landing.faq3Q: Which regions and business types are covered?
landing.faq3A: Our directory is global and welcomes all industries: We list businesses and service providers of any scale worldwide – from technology and software to dining, architecture, crafts, real estate, and professional consulting.
landing.ctaBannerSubtitle: Attract commission-free paying customers, slash expensive ad budgets, and grow your sales revenue with a 100% free permanent listing.
